description: This file defines a React component 'DeploymentStatusBarChart' that renders a themed, accessible bar chart showing deployment counts by status. It includes data processing, custom tooltips, labels, and interaction logging.

methods.name: CustomTooltip
methods.description: Renders a custom tooltip for the bar chart, showing deployment status and count.

methods.name: ValueLabel
methods.description: Displays the count value above each bar in the chart.

methods.name: auditLogInteraction
methods.description: Logs user interactions such as bar clicks and legend clicks for auditing purposes.
